patterns.note: Full-bleed, dark-themed sections dominate the page, often featuring a single, large abstract 3D render or a grid of such visuals as the primary content.
Extremely oversized, bold sans-serif typography is used as a primary visual element, often filling the screen and serving as a graphic statement rather than just text.
A stark, high-contrast black and white palette forms the foundation, with vibrant blue used sparingly as an accent color within the abstract 3D renders.
A full-screen navigation overlay animates into view, obscuring the main content and presenting menu items with a distinct, minimalist layout on a dark background.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections, each typically featuring a single dominant visual or a curated grid of abstract imagery, creating clear visual breaks.

technique_notes: A full-width video plays silently in the hero section, providing dynamic background texture and visual interest without distracting from the prominent typography.
A full-screen menu overlay animates in, typically sliding or fading, to present navigation links and contact information on a stark black background with contrasting white text.
Large-scale, high-fidelity 3D renders are used extensively as hero elements and section dividers, creating an immersive and artistic visual narrative throughout the site.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, heavy display headings (~10x body) with clean, modern sans-serif for body and navigation text.
design_tokens.radius: sharp corners are consistently used for all interactive elements and content containers.
design_tokens.spacing: airy and spacious, particularly in hero sections and menu overlays, with distinct vertical separation between content blocks.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its extreme minimalism combined with highly detailed, abstract 3D renders and a stark black-and-white palette, creating an almost art-gallery-like experience. The massive, screen-filling typography is also a key, bold feature that sets it apart.
